newsitem.title: UK: BAT seeks partner for financial arm - paper.
newsitem.headline: BAT seeks partner for financial arm - paper.

text.p: B.A.T Industries Plc is looking for a merger partner for its financial services division despite the failure of talks with Commercial Union 10 days ago, the Sunday Telegraph said.
The report said the group is keen to merge its financial arm, which owns the Allied Dunbar Insurance business in the UK.
The paper added that BAT and CU came close to agreeing a 12.5 billion stg merger which would have created one of the world's largest insurance businesses.
Last week, the Guardian newspaper reported that a secret plan to split the tobacco and financial services group had collapsed. Shares fell 10-1/2 pence on the news.
Neither BAT and CU were available for comment.
